requirement:
Create a small Node.js (CommonJS) module tested with Jest. Put the implementation in `src/formatBytes.js` and your own tests in `tests/formatBytes.test.js`; include a package.json whose only devDependency is "jest": "29.7.0". No other dependencies.

SPEC: Export `formatBytes(n)` returning a human string with 1024-based units B, KB, MB, GB, TB: integer bytes below 1024 as '<n> B', otherwise one decimal ('1.5 KB'). Negative or non-finite input throws RangeError.
